results.caption: We’ve got lots of new menu releases inbound for fast food spots and more to start the summer! BJ's Restaurant & Brewhouse has brought back its Graham Cracker S'mores Pizookie featuring a chocolate cookie topped with toasted marshmallows and vanilla ice cream. Wingstop is launching its new Sweet Heat Chamoy flavor made with Tajín beginning June 26th for rewards members before expanding to all guests. The launch also includes a new Chamoy Ranch and an exclusive Fanta Summer Punch at Coca-Cola Freestyle locations. Jack in the Box is joining the collectible cup craze with its new Jack Box Sipper Cup launching July 2nd. Each location is expected to receive between 25 and 50 cups while supplies last. Rita's has brought back its Fourth of Gelati through July 5th featuring layers of vanilla frozen custard, blue Italian ice, red Italian ice, and Firecracker Glitter. Hardee's has teamed up with NASCAR driver Bubba Wallace on a new Full Throttle Meal that comes with a collectible Bubba Wallace die-cast car while supplies last. IHOP is expanding its Dubai Chocolate lineup nationwide on June 29th following successful tests. The launch includes new Dubai Chocolate Pancakes and a Dubai Chocolate Milkshake. Potbelly has introduced a new Fiery Island Chicken Sandwich featuring fiery jerk sauce, provolone, and avocado. The chain is also serving a Confetti Cookie Shake for a limited time. And finally, The Cheesecake Factory is adding a new Brownie Crunch Choc-a-Lot Cheesecake on July 30th featuring milk and white chocolate marbled cheesecake over a crunchy toffee brownie. As an added bonus, dine-in guests can enjoy half-price slices of any cheesecake on launch day. Which of these new menu releases will you be checking out?  ##foodtok##fastfood##cheesecakefactory##ihop##foodnews

results.transcript: What if your next meal could take you from Dubai to Sichuan, Italy to Thailand and beyond? Yup, every dish on the summer menu at this restaurant in Delhi is inspired by founder Andrea Porro's food discoveries during his travels around the world, bringing global flavors straight to your table. The much-awaited Dubai lamb taco paired beautifully with the refreshing twisted berry tea. The poached Sichuan chicken brought just the right amount of heat, while the crispy pork and prawn wonton had a perfectly crisp shell and juicy filling. We loved the fresh crunch of the miso salad, the creamy gnocchi dorati and the house recipe of prawn cocktail which was as refreshing as it was pretty. For mains, the chicken a la orange was comforting and the caliente pizza with spicy chorizo and a beautifully blistered crust was an easy favorite. We wrap things up with the citrusy summer is back, perfect for Delhi's summer. So if you're in the mood to eat your way around the world, Andrea's has your boarding pass ready.
